figura.docs.FFF: A Stupid mod made because Ammedments and Supplementaries are stupid, and I wanted this fixed for the Wayfarer modpack. Might expand as needed down the road!
figura.docs.globals.FFF: Functions that exist, hopefully useful for someone. I know that TECHNICALLY /figura docs exists, but I honestly cant be arsed.
figura.docs.fff.setOffhandPlaceLock: items is a table/set of item ids (FFF:setOffhandPlaceLock({ "minecraft:lantern" }); ids without an indetifier thingy get minecraft: prepended). While the avatar is loaded, it blocks placeing/using those items in the offhand.
figura.docs.fff.getSuppQuiverVisible: Whether the Supplementaries quiver still renders for this avatar.
figura.docs.fff.hasSuppQuiver: true while the avatar's player is wearing a Supplementaries quiver
figura.docs.fff.getAmmdLantern: Whether the Amendments lantern renderer is enabled.
figura.docs.fff.setAmmdLantern: false disables the Amendments lantern in first and third person.
figura.docs.fff.getAmmdTorch: Whether the Amendments torch renderer is enabled.
figura.docs.fff.setAmmdTorch: false disables the Amendments torch in first and third person.
figura.docs.fff.getAmmdCandleHolder: Whether the Amendments candle holder renderer is enabled.
figura.docs.fff.setAmmdCandleHolder: false disables the Amendments candle holder in first and third person.
figura.docs.fff.getTryZip: true while the avatar's player is trying to zipline when holding a zipline tool (an item in the zipline:attachment tag, pickaxes by default).
figura.docs.fff.getZipping: true while the avatar's player is actually riding a zipline.
figura.docs.fff.getWATUTIdleAnimation: Whether WATUT's idle (AFK) head animation is enabled for this avatar (default true).
figura.docs.fff.setWATUTIdleAnimation: false stops WATUT from rotating this avatar's head while idle
figura.docs.fff.getWATUTIdleAnimationWou: true while the player is idle.
figura.docs.fff.getWATUTTypingAnimation: Whether WATUT's typing arm animation is enabled for this avatar (default true).
figura.docs.fff.setWATUTTypingAnimation: false stops WATUT from animating this avatar's arms while typing.
figura.docs.fff.getWATUTTypingAnimationW: true while the player is typing in chat.
figura.docs.fff.getWATUTTypingTextBox: Whether WATUT's typing chat box is enabled for this avatar (default true).
figura.docs.fff.setWATUTTypingTextBox: false stops WATUT from drawing the typing chat box
figura.docs.fff.getWATUTTypingTextBoxWou: true while the player has chat open.
figura.docs.fff.getCreateSkyhookAnimatio: Whether Create's chain hanging pose still plays for this avatar (default true).
figura.docs.fff.setCreateSkyhookAnimatio: false skips Create's chain hanging animation for this avatar's player.
figura.docs.fff.getCreateRidingChainConv: true while the avatar's player is riding a Create chain.
figura.docs.fff.getCreateCardboardBox: Whether Create's cardboard hiding-as-a-box render is enabled for this avatar (default true).
figura.docs.fff.setCreateCardboardBox: false stops Create from rendering this avatar's player as a box while sneaking in cardboard armor, and hides the matching screen blur overlay.
figura.docs.fff.getCreateCardboardStealt: true while the avatar's player is hiding as a box (cardboard armor crouch).
figura.docs.fff.getCreateCarriedVelocity: The contraption velocity at the avatar's player's position, or nil when the player isn't standing on a contraption.
figura.docs.fff.isCreateContraptionCarry: true while a Create contraption is carrying the player.
figura.docs.fff.getCreateContraptionCoun: Number of Create contraption entities near the player.
figura.docs.fff.getCreateCarriedSource: Which Create method produced the last carried velocity (getContactPointMotion, getMotionOfPoint, getContraptionMotion, or getDeltaMovement), or "none". Debug helper.
figura.docs.fff.isOnSublevel: true while the avatar's player is standing on or riding a Sable sub-level.
figura.docs.fff.getSublevelRelativeVeloc: The player's velocity relative to the Sable sublevel it is on, in world space, or nil when it isn't on one.
figura.docs.fff.getRelativeVelocity: The velocity relative to the Sable sub-level the player is on, else relative to the Create contraption it is on, else the plain vanilla velocity.
figura.docs.fff.subLevelRaycast: raycast.block, but for Sublevels. Works exactly like raycast.block when not on a sublevel.
figura.docs.fff.subLevelEntityRaycast: raycast.entity but for Sublevels. Works exactly like raycast.entity when not on a sublevel
figura.docs.fff.subLevelAabbRaycast: raycast.aabb but for Sublevels. Works exactly like raycast.aabb when not on a sublevel
